reference.note: Coordinates transferred by SIFT scan registration; reference imagery is not redistributed. Spatially balanced samples; entire grid cells reserved for validation. Not independent ground survey accuracy.

registration.algorithm: SIFT + FLANN ratio 0.65 + homography RANSAC 3 native zoom-16 pixels
registration.selection: 2000x2000 source-pixel cells; at most 8 spread points per cell; cells (x+2*y)%4==0 held out
registration.reproduction: scripts/maps/register_scans.py; candidate selection may vary with OpenCV version and feature ordering

validation.note: Holdout errors measure agreement with the SPM georeference, not absolute accuracy. Historical geometry and reference errors remain.
